on_screen_text: During the week we went up the Black Mountain and had a picnic.
We saw the whole city. It was great craic.
It was very good. We had a great view of Belfast.
Then we went to Craigavon Water Sports and did banana boating and jumped off the pier.
There's a great big lake and you fit in here.

on_screen_text: Young people have a lot of opportunities and that's great.

As I said, we emphasise the language and culture.

on_screen_text: We want to bring those kids together and give them the chance to learn and build on this basis.

I really enjoy it because everyone's very nice and we have a lot of craic.
I like being with other Irish speakers because we can just speak Irish together.
